title: Adding an iterator of values to an ordered multi-dict corrupts it
body: Bug: OrderedMultiDict.addlist('a', iter([1, 2, 3])) or with a generator leaves the dict inconsistent: keys() and repr() show the key while getlist('a') returns [] and get('a') raises IndexError. An empty generator records the key with no values so len() disagrees with keys(). Lists and tuples work.

acceptance.verify: PYTHONPATH=. mise exec pipx:pytest@9.2.0 -- pytest -q tests
